description: This file defines the Waves ripple effect library, including initialization, effect application, and event handling for ripple animations on UI elements.

methods.name: Waves.init
methods.description: Initializes the Waves effect by attaching event listeners for touch and mouse events.

methods.name: Waves.attach
methods.description: Attaches ripple effect classes to specified elements, optionally wrapping inputs and images.

methods.name: Waves.ripple
methods.description: Programmatically triggers a ripple effect on specified elements.

methods.name: Waves.calm
methods.description: Removes all ripple effects from specified elements.

methods.name: Waves.displayEffect
methods.description: Deprecated method to initialize effects, now replaced by Waves.init.
